scope: Read-only installed vLLM 0.9.2 V0 source and training log review; no GPU run, source edits or evaluation raw read

evidence.finding: n defaults to 1; project does not override n per request
Nonzero temperature and explicit seed choose RANDOM_SEED
Prefill initializes a per-request Generator.manual_seed; decode retrieves it by request_id
Only do_sample requests add sampled token rows
Incomplete chunked prefill sets do_sample=False
Seeded exponential samples drawn separately per sequence group; stride=len(seq_ids)*num_samples
RANDOM_SEED passes request generators into native sampler; max_n_in_batch=1 for project n=1
Prefix hits shorten prefill inputs and query lengths; full hit recomputes only the last token
Full cache hit charges one uncached token to scheduling budget
Normal vs prefix-enabled prefill pass different Q/K layouts and block tables to flash_attn_varlen_func
Single-sequence preemption defaults to recompute, frees blocks and resets sequence to prefill; first and every 50th preemption logs a warning
Free blocks include evictor cached blocks
Reset fails before invalidation when total-free>0; successful reset evicts all cached blocks and resets trackers/metrics
Reset applies to CPU/GPU allocators and combines return values with short-circuit and
Engine reset applies to all schedulers and returns combined boolean
Normal model output processing frees finished sequences before step returns outputs
Synchronous processing occurs before return; no-unfinished branch drains output queue
Abort removes requests from waiting/running/swapped and frees unfinished sequence blocks
Free-finished processes running and async-stopped queues and frees finished block tables
free untracks sequence, frees block table, deletes table

observed_legacy_log.interpretation: 20 post-update sync calls times two CPU/GPU prefix allocators; no observed reset-failure or preemption evidence

conclusions.seeded_sampling: No evidence that a mere batch-size/order or prefix-hit change directly consumes extra RNG under n=1 single-sequence requests. Seed alone does not imply model logits are bitwise identical.
conclusions.cache_numeric_hypothesis: Cold/warm prefix states change prefill shape, scheduling token budget and attention KV layout, allowing numerical divergence under bf16; actual causal attribution requires controlled fresh/warm/fresh replay.
conclusions.preemption_caveat: Recompute preemption returns to prefill, where this source creates a new seeded generator; this is a potential RNG restart mechanism. No preemption warning was observed in first completed arm.
conclusions.stale_weight_risk: sync_weights ignores reset boolean. A failed reset after weight refresh can retain prior-weight KV cache; normal completed collection frees requests before sync, and first completed arm logs successful resets, so stale cache is not established here.
conclusions.pruning: collect_streaming removes pending only for finished request outputs and performs pruning afterward; no active request is intentionally abandoned by pruning in its normal path.

diagnostics: Before/after sync record get_num_unfinished_requests(), each scheduler waiting/running/swapped/_async_stopped lengths, block_tables/cross_block_tables counts and num_cumulative_preemption.

Record each block_allocator._allocators entry total/free/used, evictor.num_blocks, len(_cached_blocks), cache hit metrics, reset boolean, and actor/inference weight equality. Treat unsuccessful reset after weight refresh as failure.

Use identical checkpoint/tasks/request seeds and fully drained requests for fresh-reset / warm-repeat / fresh-reset evaluation. Also use a second cold replay; compare earliest matching-prefix logits and token decisions.
Do not silently replace already prespecified endpoint with a higher repeat score. Preserve both outputs and characterize cache sensitivity independently.
limitations: Static source allows mechanisms; it cannot establish numerical kernel root cause or probability of divergence.
No installed-source modifications or live engine introspection were performed; runtime counters require a later GPU-owner diagnostic.
Log success counts establish first completed arm only; repeat log check for later arms.
